title: Venir + Gerund: Building Up to Now
goal: Say that something has been developing up to now with venir and a gerund.

sections.title: Can you do this?
items: I can say that something has been developing up to now with venir and a gerund.
I can tell venir + gerund from llevar + a length of time.
I can use the new words for trends and change over time.
